subject: english
stem:
The town wanted to reduce plastic at its summer fair. Sellers changed to returnable cups and paper bags. After the fair, plastic waste was less than half of last year's amount.
Which statement best covers the whole paragraph?
options: The town ended every kind of waste
Last year's fair had no sellers
New fair practices greatly reduced plastic waste

optionRationales.reason: The town ended every kind of waste：原文只量 plastic 且仍有剩餘。
Last year's fair had no sellers：沒有這項資訊。
New fair practices greatly reduced plastic waste：開頭目標與結尾減量結果由中段方法連接。
Sellers used paper bags：只涵蓋兩項方法之一。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「開頭設定的問題或主題與結尾給出的結果互相呼應」可推出 New fair practices greatly reduced plastic waste；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 New fair practices greatly reduced plastic waste 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
